data.title: One job, *one folder*
data.subtitle: Habit 23. Describe the finished result, then let Cowork run.

items: Describe the **finished result**, not the clicks

blocks.text: Anthropic: describe an outcome, step away, **come back to finished work**.
Claude only reads and writes in folders you've connected. Keep backups of important files.

In [folder name], read every [invoice PDF]. Make one Excel file: a row per invoice with date, supplier, amount and due date, and a total. Don't move, rename or delete anything. Show me your plan first.

items: Cowork uses **more of your limit** than a chat
Claude must ask (**Allow**) before a permanent delete
